lead.source: query3 ResearchGate generated author page excerpt only
lead.title: 0507 A pilot study evaluating preliminary efficacy of deucravacitinib compared to placebo in the treatment of moderate-to-severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS)
lead.meaning: Secondary lead only; no efficacy values, primary-source report date, analysis date or decision inferred. Next separate bounded publisher retrieval may test identity.

scope: One existing exposed trial and previously reported numbered abstract lead. Authenticate primary publisher/DOI identity, report type and chronology; no new cohort, labels, predictor derivation or scoring.

identity_contract.required: Exact NCT in primary report or an explicit authoritative source-to-trial identifier bridge. Similar titles/authors and scope concordance alone do not establish exact binding.
identity_contract.basis: Previously source-reviewed origin/protocol; planned values are not observed enrollment or efficacy.

queries.q: "A pilot study evaluating preliminary efficacy of deucravacitinib"

web_source_selection: At most six returned primary publisher/Crossref/NLM/institutional URLs or their explicit primary links. May open exact doi.org and api.crossref.org/works/{returned_DOI} metadata routes only when DOI is explicitly returned. Count each action even on access failure; no alternative mirror fishing or further search queries.
original_selection: At most three single attempts to exact URLs returned/linked or the canonical Crossref exact-work endpoint for an explicitly observed DOI. Freeze URL, exact allowed hosts, expected format and cap before dispatch. Use existing bounded transport and preserve failure bytes/journal; a new unknown hash cannot pass a known-original match control. No paywall bypass or authenticated requests.
capture: Write each request and UTC start before dispatch, full response and UTC finish after return, outcome/failure and hashes. Web response is a tool representation, not original HTTP bytes. Preserve empty/failed captures; never overwrite frozen artifacts.
allowed_local_source_access: Prior frozen source notes, projections and reviewed scope only. No raw registry status/results refresh, other trial data, clinical-label contents or raw AACT access. Baseline label artifacts may be hashed without parsing.
source_review: Exact DOI, title, author list, journal, item0507, report type and version
Exact NCT/authoritative bridge versus merely scope-concordant candidate
Planned versus observed sample, drug/dose/comparator/visit and primary endpoint correspondence; absent fields remain unknown
Publisher online-first, issue-month, conference presentation and DOI metadata creation/deposit separately
Analysis/data-cut/unblinding/decision dates only if explicitly stated; publication or submission is not a substitute
Source availability by cutoff versus later audit-only material; publication assertion does not authenticate historical exact bytes
Explicit formal decision rule and provenance; no automatic efficacy label from a p-value, descriptive change, termination or funding
date_policy: Retain day/month/year precision; never impute an exact day. Crossref created/deposited/indexed are metadata events, not first publication. Distinguish source-reported publication from historical public byte proof. Future dates remain held; report missing or conflicting publication fields explicitly.
review: Two current-source AI reviews independently sealed before sharing ratings; third technical verifier reconstructs pins, counters, source locators and actual-format projection. Source text can expose outcomes; this is an exposed research audit, not a protected holdout or independent scientific truth. No source access outside the frozen capture by reviewers.
stop_rule: Stop within bounds; do not repeat queries or broaden this case indefinitely. If primary identity, authentic rule or chronology remains insufficient, retain revise/defer source-readiness disposition. No cutoff relaxation and no passing earlier failed discovery controls by this lookup.
